<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def gcount():
    return sum(1 for row in current_frame.ascii.split('\n') for ch in row if ch=='G')
action(['LEFT']*4,intent='explore')
print("back to G9 col, G",gcount())
best=(gcount(),'here')
for i in range(8):
    r=action(['UP'],intent='explore')
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'): print("DONE UP",i); break
    g=gcount()
    if g>best[0]: best=(g,'UP'+str(i+1))
    print("UP",i+1,"G",g)
print("best",best)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
